run_workflow: run the OPAWDLDriver workflow by executing all states from start to end
init_driver: create an OPAWDLDriver instance that parses a workflow JSON file and initializes a workflow instance
run_state: run a single OPAWDL state by building and executing its shell command via subprocess
build_shell_cmd: build a shell command string from a plugin name and list of command arguments
add_state_instance: add a completed state instance to the workflow instance and persist it to the repository
